verdict.rationale: Modal's own marketing says it can 'spin up hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds' and that sandboxes are 'built for the latency' consumer AI needs. Release notes also mention a more performant backend with higher creation rates. That is a claim about fast fleet spin-up, not a documented per-sandbox cold-start figure. missing for 10: documented per-sandbox cold-start latency numbers (sub-second or few-second), benchmarks or measurement methodology, and independent or hands-on corroboration of startup times.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts

citations.quote: Spin up hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds.
built for the latency and scale consumer AI products demand
it's now possible to opt into a more performant Sandbox backend, which affords substantially higher creation rates and concurrency
